meta.title: 奶泡厚度对拉花的影响
meta.title_en: How Foam Thickness Affects Latte Art
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 奶泡厚度

scenes.context: 挖奶前：非常厚的奶泡，表面像固体。厚奶泡拉花效果：一片白色，无纹路。语域：咖啡教学，对比演示。
sentences: 非常厚的奶泡，表面像固体。
Very thick foam — the surface looks solid.
No lines can be drawn at all.
no lines at all（没有纹路）
paraphrase: 厚奶泡 → thick foam / heavy froth
像固体 → looks solid / almost stiff
scenes.speak: Very thick foam — the surface looks solid. Thick foam pours all white. No lines can be drawn at all.

scenes.context: 挖掉部分奶泡，变成拿铁厚度。拿铁厚度：纹路清晰，线条稳定。这是最适合拉花的厚度。语域：咖啡教学，对比演示。
sentences: 挖掉部分奶泡，变成拿铁厚度。
Scoop out some foam to get latte thickness.
At this thickness, the lines are crisp.
Stable lines — the sweet spot for art.
paraphrase: 拿铁厚度 → latte thickness / the medium foam
最适合 → the sweet spot / ideal
scenes.speak: Scoop out some foam to get latte thickness. At this thickness, the lines are crisp. Stable lines — the sweet spot for art.

scenes.context: 继续挖掉奶泡，变得很水。薄奶泡：纹路细腻但图案容易歪。语域：咖啡教学，对比演示。
sentences: Keep scooping and the foam gets watery.
paraphrase: 图案易歪 → the pattern tilts / drifts out of shape
pattern tilts · drifts out of shape
scenes.speak: Keep scooping and the foam gets watery. Thin foam gives fine lines. But the pattern tilts easily.

scenes.context: 从左到右：厚、中、薄、极薄，四档对比。几乎没泡：纹路细密但完全无法控制方向。在两个杯子间来回倒，配合摇动混合奶泡。语域：咖啡教学，总结对比。
sentences: Left to right: thick, medium, thin, ultra-thin.
几乎没泡，纹路完全失控。
With almost no foam, the lines go wild.
在两个杯子间来回倒，混合奶泡。
Pour between two pitchers to mix the foam.
paraphrase: 四档 → four levels / a four-way comparison
失控 → go wild / out of control
scenes.speak: Left to right: thick, medium, thin, ultra-thin. With almost no foam, the lines go wild. Pour between two pitchers to mix the foam.

practice: At this thickness, the lines are crisp.
Thin foam gives fine lines, but the pattern tilts easily.
Left to right: thick, medium, thin, ultra-thin.
pitfalls: Very thick foam — the surface looks solid.
Scoop out some foam to get latte thickness.
「挖掉奶泡」用 scoop out some foam。
With almost no foam, the lines go wild.
shifts: 用 thick foam（厚）、latte thickness（拿铁厚度）、thin foam（薄）、ultra-thin（极薄）
用 lines are crisp（清晰）、fine lines（细腻）、go wild（失控）
用 scoop out（挖掉）、watery（很水）、pour between pitchers（倒缸混合）
